programme.title: Crime Investigation Australia
programme.sub-title: The Mystery Of The Homestead Murders
programme.desc: Mick and Sue Lewis were murdered in their country home. The two unharmed children were left to fend for themselves - along with their parents' decomposing bodies.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia
programme.desc: In September 2012, Jill Meagher's night out ended in tragedy, sparking outrage over a flawed parole system.

programme.title: Homicide With Ron Iddles
programme.desc: A mother of two mysteriously disappears a week before Christmas. Police think shes run away with her lover. Her husband holds a media conferences appealing for her to come home.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives
programme.desc: Decades after a string of multi-state home invasions and sexual assaults went cold, advanced genetic genealogy finally unmasked a serial offender who died in 1997.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter
programme.desc: When two women are gunned down, Kenda has to determine who was the target. The case takes a turn when he learns a woman was recently murdered under similar circumstances.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives
programme.desc: Between 2006 and 2008, six women are raped in Fayetteville. In 2018, DNA genealogy identifies serial predator Darold Wayne Bowden.

programme.title: Killer At The Crime Scene
programme.desc: Teams of detectives and forensic scientists examine the evidence left behind in the case of two women whose dismembered body parts were found inside bins. That led to the arrest of Anthony Hardy, who became known as The Camden Ripper.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: An irate shopper winds up on the receiving end of an electroshock weapon; an incoherent former Marine cannot explain his violent actions; a traffic stop proves to be anything but routine.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: With officers on his trail, a suspect's world comes crashing down. A woman calls deputies to apprehend her hostile husband. During a traffic stop, one passenger tries to outrun the police and his past.

programme.title: Britain's Hotel Murders
programme.desc: A celebratory night ends in horror as 21-year-old Hayden Fitzpatrick falls from the fifth floor of a Manchester hotel. What transpired in room 130 to meet the violent end?

programme.title: The Killer In My Family

programme.desc: Kenneth learns working for Tracy is more than he bargained for. Liz struggles to keep egomaniacal Jack out of the writers' room & scantily clad Cerie in her clothes.

programme.desc: Jack fears Liz is leading a life of mediocrity and appoints himself her mentor. Meanwhile, Liz needs to deal with a physically altered cast member.

programme.desc: Jack bumps Jenna's Late Night With Conan O'Brien spot by booking Tracy. Still irate over the show becoming TGS With Tracy Jordan, Jenna lashes out at Liz.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Fed up with her boorish boyfriend Dennis, Liz sends him packing & hits the New York singles scene under Jenna's guidance. Meanwhile, Jack has his own relationship woes.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: When clueless receptionist Cerie announces her engagement to a wealthy heir, Liz contemplates her own marital & maternal future while Jack crumbles under his mummy issues.

programme.desc: Jenna is mad at Liz because she thinks her new indie film is terrible, and Jack helps Tracy create and market a new cooking machine.

programme.desc: Liz and Jenna decide to get serious about their dating lives, but find themselves unexpectedly switching their roles.

programme.desc: Liz wonders if she's actually on a date with Jack as she joins him at a birthday celebration for a foreign prince. Back at 30 Rock, Tracy tempts Pete with a party in the office.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: After the entire cast binges on questionable seafood at the craft services table, they hunker down to pull an all nighter on Valentine's Day & cobble a new show together.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Realising she has to be more lenient with her staff, Liz adopts a more lax leadership style. Meanwhile, Jack takes Tracy along to an exclusive GE charity golf event.

programme.title: 30 Rock
programme.desc: Liz tries to keep Josh from jumping to a rival show. Tracy awards Kenneth a spot in his entourage. Jenna gets into hot water over a misquote in a magazine.

programme.desc: Jack persuades Ghostface Killah & producer Ridikolus to endorse Donaghy Estates. Meanwhile, Kenneth catches the eye of Ridikolus' girlfriend.

programme.desc: Jack helps his unlucky brother Eddie with a job, but can the crew handle two Donaghys? Liz makes staff cutbacks & everyone tries to please her to avoid the axe.

programme.desc: Threatened by a sneaky West Coast NBC executive, Jack enlists Kenneth to help thwart any attempts to usurp Donaghy's TV throne. Meanwhile, Tracy is served with paternity papers.
